class PrivateFirst { private value = 1; }
class PrivateSecond { private value = 2; }
function privateUnion(value: PrivateFirst | PrivateSecond) { console.log(value.value); }
type ReadonlyUnion = {readonly value: number} | {readonly value: number; tag: string};
function readonlyUnion(value: ReadonlyUnion) { value.value = 2; }
